services.title: Water Damage Restoration
services.description: Professional water damage restoration using IICRC S500 protocols. 24/7 emergency response for burst pipes, flooding, and water extraction.
services.metaDescription: Expert water damage restoration services across Australia. IICRC certified technicians, 24/7 emergency response. Call 1300 309 361 for immediate assistance.

faqs.question: How quickly can you respond to water damage emergencies?
faqs.answer: We provide 24/7 emergency response with rapid dispatch - we aim to connect you with technicians as quickly as possible, typically within 60 minutes in major metro areas. Rapid response is critical to prevent secondary damage like mould growth and structural deterioration.

faqs.question: What equipment do you use for water extraction?
faqs.answer: We use industrial-grade extraction equipment including truck-mounted extractors, high-velocity air movers, commercial dehumidifiers, and thermal imaging cameras to detect hidden moisture.

faqs.question: Will my insurance cover water damage restoration?
faqs.answer: Most comprehensive home insurance policies cover sudden and accidental water damage. We work directly with all major Australian insurers and provide detailed documentation to support your claim.

faqs.question: How long does the water damage restoration process take?
faqs.answer: Typical restoration takes 3-7 days depending on the extent of damage. We use moisture meters to ensure complete drying before reconstruction begins.

faqs.question: Can you prevent mould growth after water damage?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our IICRC S500 protocols include antimicrobial treatments and complete structural drying within 24-48 hours to prevent mould colonization.

services.title: Flood Restoration
services.description: Complete flood restoration services for Category 1-3 water damage. Expert flood cleanup, structural drying, and contamination control.
services.metaDescription: Professional flood restoration services. IICRC certified flood damage specialists. 24/7 emergency response across Australia. Call 1300 309 361.

faqs.question: What categories of flood water can you handle?
faqs.answer: We handle all categories: Category 1 (clean water), Category 2 (grey water), and Category 3 (black water). Each requires specific protocols and safety equipment.

faqs.question: Do you remove contaminated materials after flooding?
faqs.answer: Yes. Category 3 flood water requires removal of porous materials like carpets, drywall, and insulation that cannot be safely cleaned.

faqs.question: How do you sanitize after flood damage?
faqs.answer: We use EPA-registered antimicrobial treatments, HEPA air scrubbers, and ozone generators to eliminate bacteria, viruses, and odours from flood water.

services.title: Burst Pipe Restoration
services.description: Emergency burst pipe restoration and water damage repair. Rapid water extraction, structural drying, and restoration services.
services.metaDescription: Emergency burst pipe restoration services. 24/7 response, rapid water extraction, complete restoration. Call 1300 309 361 now.

faqs.question: What should I do immediately after a pipe bursts?
faqs.answer: Turn off the main water supply, turn off electricity in affected areas, move valuables to safety, and call us immediately at 1300 309 361 for emergency response.

faqs.question: Can you detect hidden water damage from burst pipes?
faqs.answer: Yes. We use thermal imaging cameras, moisture meters, and hygrometers to detect water in walls, ceilings, and subfloors.

services.title: Structural Drying Services
services.description: Advanced structural drying using thermal imaging and moisture monitoring. Complete drying of walls, floors, and building cavities.
services.metaDescription: Professional structural drying services using IICRC S500 protocols. Advanced moisture detection and complete building drying. Call 1300 309 361.

faqs.question: How do you ensure complete structural drying?
faqs.answer: We use moisture meters, thermo-hygrometers, and thermal imaging to monitor moisture levels daily. Drying continues until all materials reach acceptable moisture content levels per IICRC standards.

faqs.question: What is the difference between surface drying and structural drying?
faqs.answer: Surface drying only removes visible water. Structural drying targets moisture trapped in walls, subfloors, and building cavities using specialized equipment and scientific drying protocols.

services.title: Fire Damage Restoration
services.description: Complete fire damage restoration using IICRC FSRT protocols. Soot removal, smoke odour elimination, and structural restoration.
services.metaDescription: Expert fire damage restoration services. IICRC FSRT certified technicians. Smoke odour removal and complete restoration. Call 1300 309 361.

faqs.question: Can you remove smoke odour completely?
faqs.answer: Yes. We use thermal fogging, ozone treatments, hydroxyl generators, and HEPA air scrubbers to eliminate smoke odours from all surfaces and materials.

faqs.question: How do you clean soot from walls and ceilings?
faqs.answer: We use dry sponges, HEPA vacuums, and specialized cleaning solutions based on soot type (dry, wet, protein, or fuel oil). Each requires different cleaning techniques per IICRC FSRT standards.

faqs.question: Will insurance cover fire damage restoration?
faqs.answer: Yes. Fire damage is typically covered under standard home and business insurance policies. We work directly with insurers and provide comprehensive documentation.

faqs.question: How long does fire damage restoration take?
faqs.answer: Minor fire damage takes 1-2 weeks. Major fires requiring structural work can take 2-6 months depending on the extent of damage and reconstruction needed.

services.title: Smoke Damage Restoration
services.description: Professional smoke damage cleanup and odour elimination. HEPA filtration, thermal fogging, and complete smoke residue removal.
services.metaDescription: Professional smoke damage restoration. Complete odour elimination and soot removal. IICRC FSRT certified technicians. Call 1300 309 361.

faqs.question: Can smoke damage affect my health?
faqs.answer: Yes. Smoke residue contains carcinogens, acids, and toxic particles. Professional cleanup using HEPA filtration and proper PPE is essential for safety.

faqs.question: What items can be saved after smoke damage?
faqs.answer: Most hard surfaces, electronics, and sealed items can be cleaned. Porous materials like upholstery may require specialized ozone or thermal treatment.

services.title: Mould Remediation
services.description: Professional mould remediation and removal. Containment, HEPA filtration, spore removal, and prevention protocols.
services.metaDescription: Expert mould remediation services. IICRC certified technicians, complete mould removal, air quality testing. Call 1300 309 361.

faqs.question: Is black mould dangerous?
faqs.answer: Stachybotrys (black mould) can produce mycotoxins that cause respiratory issues, allergies, and other health problems. Professional remediation is essential for safe removal.

faqs.question: How do you prevent mould from returning?
faqs.answer: We identify and fix moisture sources, apply antimicrobial treatments, and recommend ventilation improvements and dehumidification to maintain humidity below 60%.

faqs.question: Do you provide mould testing?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer air quality testing, surface sampling, and moisture mapping to identify mould species and extent of contamination.

faqs.question: Can I stay in my home during mould remediation?
faqs.answer: For minor mould (less than 10 square feet), yes. Large-scale remediation requires containment and negative air pressure, making the area uninhabitable during work.

services.title: Black Mould Removal
services.description: Safe black mould (Stachybotrys) removal using containment, HEPA filtration, and certified protocols. Protect your family's health.
services.metaDescription: Professional black mould removal. IICRC certified specialists, complete containment, air quality testing. Call 1300 309 361.

faqs.question: What makes black mould more dangerous than other mould?
faqs.answer: Black mould (Stachybotrys chartarum) produces mycotoxins that can cause severe respiratory issues, chronic fatigue, and neurological symptoms in sensitive individuals.

faqs.question: How do you safely remove black mould?
faqs.answer: We use full containment with plastic barriers, negative air machines with HEPA filters, PPE equipment, and HEPA vacuuming to prevent spore spread during removal.

faqs.question: What biohazards do you clean up?
faqs.answer: We clean blood, bodily fluids, tissue, pathogenic bacteria, viruses, drug residue, sharps, and contaminated materials requiring specialized handling and disposal.

faqs.question: Are biohazard cleanup services confidential?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide discreet, unmarked vehicles and maintain complete confidentiality for all trauma, crime scene, and biohazard cleanup services.

faqs.question: What certifications do your technicians have?
faqs.answer: Our technicians are certified in bloodborne pathogen handling, OSHA safety standards, and hold specialized biohazard remediation certifications.

services.title: Meth Lab Decontamination
services.description: Certified methamphetamine lab decontamination. Chemical residue removal, air quality testing, and property clearance certification.
services.metaDescription: Professional meth lab decontamination services. Certified cleanup, clearance testing, property restoration. Call 1300 309 361.

faqs.question: How do you test for meth contamination?
faqs.answer: We use surface wipe sampling analyzed by NATA-accredited laboratories to measure methamphetamine levels against state-specific guidelines (typically 0.5 μg/100cm² in Australia).

faqs.question: Can a property be restored after meth lab contamination?
faqs.answer: Yes. Professional decontamination can restore most properties. The process includes removal of contaminated materials, chemical cleaning, and verification testing to meet clearance levels.

faqs.question: Is meth contamination dangerous?
faqs.answer: Yes. Meth residue contains toxic chemicals that can cause respiratory issues, skin irritation, neurological problems, and developmental issues in children even at low levels.

faqs.question: What safety precautions do you take for sewage cleanup?
faqs.answer: Our technicians use full PPE including respirators, contamination suits, and gloves. We establish containment zones and use EPA-registered disinfectants for pathogen elimination.

faqs.question: Should I replace water-damaged ceiling drywall?
faqs.answer: It depends on severity. Minor staining can be cleaned and repainted. Sagging, crumbling, or mould-contaminated drywall must be replaced for safety and structural integrity.

faqs.question: How do you find the source of ceiling leaks?
faqs.answer: We use thermal imaging cameras, moisture meters, and pressure testing to trace water intrusion from roofs, HVAC systems, or upper-floor plumbing.

faqs.question: Can water-damaged carpet be saved?
faqs.answer: Category 1 clean water damage can often be saved if dried within 24-48 hours. Category 3 contaminated water requires carpet replacement per IICRC guidelines.

faqs.question: How do you dry wet carpet?
faqs.answer: We use truck-mounted extractors, high-velocity air movers, and dehumidifiers. Carpet is lifted for subfloor drying, and moisture levels are monitored daily.

services.title: Basement Flooding Restoration
services.description: Complete basement flooding restoration. Water extraction, structural drying, mould prevention, and waterproofing solutions.
services.metaDescription: Emergency basement flooding restoration. Rapid water removal, complete drying, mould prevention. Call 1300 309 361.

faqs.question: What causes basement flooding?
faqs.answer: Common causes include sump pump failure, foundation cracks, blocked gutters, poor drainage, sewer backups, and heavy rainfall overwhelming drainage systems.

faqs.question: How do you prevent mould in flooded basements?
faqs.answer: We extract water within hours, use industrial dehumidifiers to maintain low humidity, apply antimicrobial treatments, and ensure complete drying within 48-72 hours.
